title: Use battery percentage thresholds to predict task acceptance and automatic shutdown behavior
summary: Use the robot’s current battery percentage to predict whether it will accept new tasks and whether it will turn off automatically. The guidance provided is: under 20% it will not accept new tasks; at 15% it turns off automatically and you cannot turn it on until it is taken to a charger.
when_to_use: Use when you need to decide whether a robot with a given battery percentage is likely to accept new tasks and whether it may shut off automatically (and therefore be unavailable) based on the battery threshold behavior described in the source.
not_for: Do not use this guidance as a substitute for troubleshooting when observed behavior does not match the documented thresholds; escalate instead.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Check the robot’s battery percentage on the system/HMI and apply the threshold expectations for task acceptance and shutdown behavior.
safety_notes: Avoid operating the robot anywhere close to 15% battery, because at 15% it turns off automatically and cannot be turned on until moved to a charger.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the robot battery percentage display (HMI/system view)

access_required: Ability to view the robot’s current battery percentage on the system/HMI

visual_references.description: Frame/transcript evidence for the battery threshold behavior: under 20% no new tasks; at 15% automatic turn-off and cannot be turned on until taken to a charger.

steps.title: Check the robot’s current battery percentage (as shown in the system/HMI)
steps.purpose: Determine which battery threshold bucket the robot is in so you can predict task acceptance and shutdown behavior.
steps.instruction: On the system/HMI, locate the robot’s current battery percentage and note the value.
steps.expected_result: You have the robot’s current battery percentage value available to compare against the thresholds (20% and 15%).
steps.healthy_condition: Battery percentage is visible and readable for the specific robot you are evaluating.
steps.failure_condition: Battery percentage is not visible/readable for the robot, or you cannot determine the current percentage.

actions.label: Read battery percentage
actions.exact_action: Check the robot’s current battery percentage (as shown in the system/HMI).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Under 20% it will not accept any new task; at 15% it will turn off automatically and cannot be turned on until taken to a charger.

steps.title: If battery is under 20%, expect the robot will not accept any new task
steps.purpose: Prevent attempting to assign work to a robot that is expected to reject new tasks due to low battery.
steps.instruction: If the robot’s battery percentage is below 20%, treat it as not accepting new tasks.
steps.expected_result: Based on the threshold guidance, you predict the robot will not accept any new task when battery is under 20%.
steps.healthy_condition: Your operational decision aligns with the threshold: you do not rely on the robot to take new tasks when it is under 20%.
steps.failure_condition: The robot accepts new tasks despite being under 20% (behavior does not match the documented threshold guidance).

actions.label: Compare battery to 20% threshold
actions.exact_action: If battery is under 20%, expect the robot will not accept any new task.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the observed behavior does not match the documented thresholds, stop relying on the threshold guidance and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript near this frame: 'And I think under 20% it... will not accept any new task.'

steps.title: If battery is at/near 15%, expect automatic turn-off and inability to turn it back on
steps.purpose: Avoid operating near the shutdown threshold and plan for the robot to be unavailable until it is moved to a charger.
steps.instruction: If the robot’s battery percentage is at or near 15%, expect it to turn off automatically and that you cannot turn it on; plan to move it to a charger (e.g., using a dolly or carrying it to the charger and pushing down, per the source guidance).
steps.expected_result: You predict the robot will turn off automatically at 15% and you cannot turn it on until it is taken to a charger.
steps.healthy_condition: You avoid operating the robot anywhere close to 15% battery and instead route it toward charging when it approaches that threshold.
steps.failure_condition: The robot remains available/does not turn off automatically at ~15% battery, or you are able to turn it on without taking it to a charger (behavior does not match the documented threshold guidance).

actions.label: Compare battery to 15% threshold
actions.exact_action: If battery is at/near 15%, expect the robot will turn off automatically and you may not be able to turn it on.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the observed behavior does not match the documented thresholds, stop relying on the threshold guidance and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript near this frame: '...at 15% it... will turn off automatically. So you can't even turn it on. You'll have to some, you have to use a Dolly or have to carry it to the charger and push down.'

steps.title: Avoid operating near 15% and monitor for charging instead of continuing to run
steps.purpose: Reduce the chance of unexpected shutdown and task rejection by keeping the robot away from the low-battery thresholds.
steps.instruction: When planning robot usage, avoid running the robot anywhere close to 15%. If you see low battery approaching the thresholds, prioritize conditions that allow it to charge rather than continuing to run.
steps.expected_result: Operational decisions reduce the likelihood of the robot turning off automatically (at 15%) or rejecting new tasks (under 20%).
steps.healthy_condition: Robots are not being operated near the 15% threshold; you plan charging when battery is low enough to risk shutdown.
steps.failure_condition: You continue operating a robot near 15% battery and it turns off automatically or becomes unavailable.

actions.label: Plan away from 15%
actions.exact_action: Avoid operating the robot anywhere close to 15% and monitor for conditions where it can charge instead of continuing to run.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the observed behavior does not match the documented thresholds, stop relying on the threshold guidance and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript near this frame: 'So we don't wanna be anywhere close to 15 percent.'

success_criteria: You can correctly predict task acceptance and shutdown behavior from the battery thresholds: under 20% = no new tasks; at 15% = automatic turn-off and cannot be turned on until taken to a charger.
healthy_conditions: Robot battery percentage is known and decisions are made using the 20% and 15% thresholds.
failure_conditions: Observed robot behavior does not match the documented thresholds (under 20% task acceptance behavior; at 15% automatic turn-off and inability to turn on without charging).
escalation_guidance: If the observed behavior does not match the documented thresholds, stop relying on the threshold guidance and escalate to support.
